# UI Breakdown: Transit App Home Screen

## 1) Top Header/Banner
- **"Plan your journey" banner**: Large rounded rectangle (~28px corner radius), diagonal gradient from **magenta/pink (#E91E63)** bottom-left to **bright red (#F5222D / #FF3B30)** top-right
- Small row: right-pointing arrow icon (→) + "Plan your journey" in white, regular weight
- Below: "Where would you like to go?" in white, **bold**, large (~28px)
- Banner sits on a light gray/off-white page background (#F5F5F5)

## 2) Sections (top to bottom)

### A. Quick Access Card
- White card, fully rounded (~28px), soft shadow
- 4 circular icon buttons (~72px) with labels below in dark gray semibold:
  - **Bus** — yellow circle (#FBE18C) with dark brown/maroon bus icon
  - **Train** — light green circle (#BFD8B8) with dark green train icon
  - **Metro** — light blue circle (#A8D4F0) with dark navy metro/tram icon
  - **Search** — gray circle (#8E8E8E) with white magnifying glass icon

### B. Favorites
- Section title: "Favorites" in gray (#9E9E9E), bold, left-aligned
- Horizontally scrollable pill chips (white/light gray, thin border, fully rounded):
  - "d Home" (partially cut off — likely "Add Home"), cut off on left edge
  - **⊕ Add Work** — red plus-in-circle icon, dark bold text
  - **⊕ Add Favourites** — same style

### C. Promo Carousel Card
- Large banner card, rounded (~24px), **amber/mustard yellow (#F0A830)** background with lighter yellow arc behind illustration
- Left text (black):
  - "Setup Safety Now!" — very large, extra bold
  - "Safe and Reliable Rides" — medium weight
- Right illustration: dark phone held by hands, red circular "SOS" button on screen, green shield with white checkmark (with motion lines) at top-right
- Page dots below: 4 dots — 3 gray (inactive), 1 black (active, last)

### D. Explore
- Title "Explore" in dark bold
- Floating **blue circular-square FAB** (#1A56DB, rounded ~24px) overlapping the row: QR-scan icon (white) + label "BUS QR" in white bold
- Category chips row:
  - **Heritage** — active: dark slate gray (#5A6472) pill, white text + white castle/landmark icon
  - **Museum** — inactive white pill, dark text + orange icon (partially hidden by FAB)
  - **Park** — white pill, dark text + green tree icon

## 3) Bottom Navigation
White bar, 5 items, inactive gray (#9E9E9E), active red:
| Item | Icon | State |
|---|---|---|
| Home | flag/banner icon | **Active — red (#E53935)**, bold black label |
| Services | 4-dot grid | gray |
| Live | circle/ring | gray |
| Ticket | ticket icon | gray |
| Profile | person icon | gray |

Note: active item icon is red but label appears black/bold.

## 4) Exact Text Labels
- "Plan your journey" / "Where would you like to go?"
- "Bus", "Train", "Metro", "Search"
- "Favorites"
- "d Home", "Add Work", "Add Favourites"
- "Setup Safety Now!" / "Safe and Reliable Rides" / "SOS"
- "Explore" / "BUS QR"
- "Heritage", "Museum", "Park"
- "Home", "Services", "Live", "Ticket", "Profile"

## 5) Color Palette
- **Primary red**: #E53935–#F5222D (banner, active nav, plus icons)
- **Magenta**: #E91E63 (gradient end)
- **Amber/yellow**: #F0A830, #F5C842 (promo card)
- **Blue**: #1A56DB (BUS QR FAB), #A8D4F0 (metro circle)
- **Green**: #BFD8B8, #2E7D32 (train circle, shield, park icon)
- **Yellow**: #FBE18C (bus circle)
- **Slate gray**: #5A6472 (active chip)
- **Neutral gray**: #8E8E8E, #9E9E9E, #F5F5F5 (background)
- **Text**: black/dark gray (#1A1A1A), white on colored surfaces
- **Typography**: Rounded sans-serif (Nunito/Quicksand-like), heavy weights for headings
